algorithm: Parse the successor corpus root, rights manifest, split root, holdout report, and leakage report as JSON.
Require RESULT(PGIR-200), RESULT(PGIR-201), and RESULT(PGIR-202) identities in those artifacts.
Require admitted_source_rows=0, materialized_source_rows=0, materialized=false, training_eligible=false, and training_admitted_rows=0.
Require leakage_passed=true and the inherited public hidden-test commitment; never open or enumerate hidden-test membership.
Require every listed stratum to have denominator zero and permanent_no_go/no_rights_admitted_materialized_rows.
Require the historical R1 report CID to match the historical manifest, while treating its fixture metrics as historical only.
Conclude retirement rather than calculate an R1 metric.

independence.method: Read-only source recomputation from the listed predecessor and successor artifacts; no compiler, decompiler, fixture, network, cache, or hidden-test access is used.
